Bard.laning: If Bard W Caretaker's Shrine appears in lane, walk over it to destroy it. If you push the wave with Zyra Q Deadly Spines and plants, use that time to get vision or roam.
Bard.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Bard's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a champion with strong healing, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so don't stand with a wall behind you or in a line with an ally or minion. Bard can enter from the side with Bard E Magical Journey, so don't leave that approach open; if he engages, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots. Watch for the damage immunity from Bard R Tempered Fate, and don't commit damage to targets caught in its area.
Bard.combo: After Bard E Magical Journey is down, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where he is rooted, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed while the ability is traveling to give Bard less time to dodge. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the plants you have summoned.
Bard.escape: Right after you force Bard to use Bard E Magical Journey, you have a chance to close in and engage. Choose an approach that avoids lining up with a wall or another target, so you can avoid the stun from Bard Q Cosmic Binding. If Zyra E Grasping Roots is down, back off because you have no way to withstand a counterattack.
Bard.fight: Start a trade with Zyra E Grasping Roots when Bard steps forward to protect his ADC or place a ward. Immediately after Bard E Magical Journey is used, reposition for another angle and land a root followed by Zyra R Stranglethorns. Back off if Zyra E Grasping Roots misses or while waiting for it to become available again.
Bard.phase: In the late game, Bard can escape a root with Bard E Magical Journey, so secure an advantage through vision and objectives beforehand.
Bard.teamfight: Start from behind your allies at the edge of your range, placing seeds ahead of time where your allies can stand and along the routes Bard's side will use to approach. Cut off their engage through Bard E Magical Journey with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over plants, and after the knockup, use the Zyra E Grasping Roots you held back to root the enemy as they land.

Alistar.phase: In the late game, one Zyra E Grasping Roots is unlikely to decide a fight, so block the approach from behind your allies.
Alistar.teamfight: Prepare seeds along Alistar's approach from behind your allies, then cut off his path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns when he engages. While Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don't spend your damage on him; back off, then fight again. Target the damage dealers behind him instead of focusing Alistar for too long.
Alistar.combo: When you can root Alistar, start with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where he is rooted, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over plants from Zyra P Garden of Thorns or W to enrage them. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, back off instead of committing your damage. When you need to stop his engage, after he activates R, disrupt him again with Zyra E Grasping Roots or Zyra R Stranglethorns.
Alistar.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance against Alistar's main damage. If the healing from Alistar P Triumphant Roar is a problem, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Alistar.escape: The moment Alistar W Headbutt is down is your window to close in and attack. If Alistar Q Pulverize is down too, use that time to reposition or counterattack by rooting him with Zyra E Grasping Roots.
Alistar.fight: Close in to counterattack right after Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt are down. Hit an Alistar walking forward with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then deal damage with seeds and Zyra Q Deadly Spines. If E misses, back off.
Alistar.laning: Look for opportunities when Alistar steps forward to protect his ADC or place a ward, but if E is down, retreat and build up seeds. If you push the wave, use that time to get vision or roam.
Alistar.watch: If Alistar closes the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, he can follow up with the knockup from Alistar Q Pulverize and the stun from Alistar E Trample, so keep enough distance to use Zyra E Grasping Roots. Near a turret, don't give Alistar room to come around behind Zyra and push her under it.

Lulu.escape: Look to close the distance after Lulu uses Lulu W Whimsy on another ally. Lulu has no dash to escape with, so root her with Zyra E Grasping Roots and follow with Zyra R Stranglethorns. Keep your distance if Lulu W Whimsy is still available or Zyra E Grasping Roots misses.
Lulu.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and buy Mercury's Treads. Lulu deals mostly magic damage, and Zyra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lulu.combo: When Lulu steps forward, root her with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where she’s rooted, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed while Zyra E Grasping Roots is traveling to give Lulu less time to dodge or step on it. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants.
Lulu.fight: When Lulu steps forward to protect her carry or place a ward, start a trade with Zyra E Grasping Roots. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back away.
Lulu.laning: Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion’s bonus damage can hit another unit instead, so take basic attack harassment from behind minions. Push the wave with Zyra Q Deadly Spines and your plants, but against champions, root them with Zyra E Grasping Roots before hitting them with Zyra Q Deadly Spines. If you push the wave, use that time to establish vision or roam.
Lulu.phase: Later in the game, it becomes harder to decide a fight with a single root, so secure an advantage with vision and objectives beforehand.
Lulu.teamfight: From behind your allies, place seeds along the route enemies will use to engage, then stop them with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns as they come in. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants to empower them. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, target Lulu or someone else rather than focusing all your attacks on the protected target.
Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy silences you and prevents you from attacking, so don’t approach closely while it’s available. Keep your distance while dodging the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance, and don’t try to burst down a protected target while Lulu R Wild Growth is available.

Braum.fight: Start a trade with Zyra E Grasping Roots when Braum steps forward to protect his ADC or place a ward. If Braum E Unbreakable is blocking the front, wait for it to come down or find an angle from the side his shield isn't facing. Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is used, look for a chance to catch him with Zyra E Grasping Roots or Zyra R Stranglethorns.
Braum.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Braum's main damage is magic and Zyra has relatively low magic resistance, so build that resistance first. Tenacity against Braum's stun and knockup also matters because Zyra has no escape ability.
Braum.combo: When Braum E Unbreakable comes down and you have an angle to hit with Zyra E Grasping Roots, root him with it, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed there, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. After casting Zyra E Grasping Roots, place the seed along its path to give Braum less time to dodge or step on it. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the plants you have summoned.
Braum.escape: Right after you force Braum to use Braum W Stand Behind Me, you have a window to land Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns. Wait until Braum E Unbreakable comes down before looking for an angle to attack. If Zyra E Grasping Roots is unavailable, don't engage first; keep your distance.
Braum.laning: Manage your distance from behind minions so you can dodge Braum Q Winter's Bite. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses or has been used, back off and build up seeds because you have no way to withstand a counterattack. If you push the wave, use that time to get vision or roam.
Braum.phase: In the late game, Braum can dodge a root with a mobility ability like Braum W Stand Behind Me, so it's hard to rely on one Zyra E Grasping Roots.
Braum.teamfight: Fight from behind your allies, placing seeds where they can stand and along Braum's approach before the fight. When Braum engages, cut off his path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns cast over plants. While Braum E Unbreakable is blocking the front, find an angle from the side his shield isn't facing, and stay off the line of Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Braum.watch: Braum Q Winter's Bite only hits the first enemy it reaches, so stand behind minions and avoid moments when there's a gap between them and you're directly in line with Braum. If Braum P Concussive Blows marks you, get out of range before more stacks build up. When you see the cast animation for Braum R Glacial Fissure, dodge sideways from its line and avoid the slow zone left behind.

Blitzcrank.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Blitzcrank's main damage is magic, and Zyra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Magic resistance does not block the physical damage from Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Blitzcrank.combo: When Blitzcrank steps forward or misses Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where he is rooted, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. After casting Zyra E Grasping Roots, place the seed along its path to give him less time to dodge or step on it. Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier may activate, so secure a finishing tool before focusing him.
Blitzcrank.escape: The moment Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is down is your chance to step forward and trade. Blitzcrank has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you catch him with Zyra E Grasping Roots, you can follow up with Zyra R Stranglethorns. If Zyra E Grasping Roots doesn't hit, create distance again.
Blitzcrank.fight: Start a trade with Zyra E Grasping Roots right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or when he is low on mana. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back off because you have few ways to withstand a counterattack.
Blitzcrank.laning: Don't stand side by side with the minions; keep them in front of you to block Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Use a Control Ward to secure vision in bushes, and stay far from bushes you can't see into. If his hook misses, use the opening to push the wave or trade. When Zyra E Grasping Roots is down, back off and build up seeds.
Blitzcrank.phase: In the late game, it's harder to gain an advantage with one Zyra E Grasping Roots, so secure an advantage through vision and objectives beforehand.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: From behind your allies, Zyra should place seeds along the enemy's approach and start fights at the edge of her range. If Blitzcrank approaches, cut off his path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the plants that have grown. Keep your distance first so Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab doesn't catch you.
Blitzcrank.watch: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls you in, he can easily follow up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank R Static Field. Stand with minions between you and him, and stay far from bushes when you don't have vision in them. If Blitzcrank approaches with Blitzcrank W Overdrive, keep your distance and stop him with Zyra E Grasping Roots.

Brand.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, and build magic resistance to counter Brand's main damage.
Brand.combo: The basic sequence is to root with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed there, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed along the path while the ability is in flight to give Brand less time to dodge or step on it. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the plants you have summoned.
Brand.escape: The moment Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is your chance to close in. If you aren't ablaze, Brand Q Sear won't stun you, so root Brand with Zyra E Grasping Roots and follow with Zyra R Stranglethorns if needed.
Brand.fight: Trade after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down if he remains within Zyra E Grasping Roots range. Root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then layer seeds and Zyra Q Deadly Spines. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back off because it's hard to withstand a counterattack.
Brand.laning: Stay away from minions Brand has set ablaze. If you push the wave, gain an advantage through vision or roaming.
Brand.phase: In the late game, it's harder to catch someone with one Zyra E Grasping Roots, so secure an advantage through vision and objectives beforehand.
Brand.teamfight: Prepare seeds along the enemy's approach from behind your allies, then cut off the path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns when they engage. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the plants you have summoned to strengthen their attacks. Keep your distance from your allies so Brand E Conflagration and Brand R Pyroclasm don't spread, and don't stand next to an ally who is burning.
Brand.watch: After Brand P Blaze is applied, taking other abilities in quick succession builds stacks that explode, so focus on dodging his opening attack, Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand Q Sear. If Brand Q Sear hits you while you're burning, it stuns you, so get out of the projectile's path or hide behind a minion. Brand E Conflagration can spread from a burning minion, so stay away while you last-hit.

Heimerdinger.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Heimerdinger's main damage is magic, and Zyra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Heimerdinger.combo: Root Heimerdinger with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed there, then hit him with Zyra Q Deadly Spines. If you place the seed while Zyra E Grasping Roots is in flight, Heimerdinger has less time to dodge or step on it. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the plants you have summoned to strengthen them; when the vines contract, they can knock Heimerdinger up.
Heimerdinger.escape: Root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots and follow with Zyra R Stranglethorns, but check your distance from turret range first because Zyra has no escape ability.
Heimerdinger.fight: Don't repeatedly trade in front of Heimerdinger's turret setup; target Heimerdinger himself from the side or a bush.
Heimerdinger.laning: Use Zyra E Grasping Roots first when Heimerdinger steps forward or you get an angle from the side of his turret setup. If it misses, back off and build up seeds. If you push the wave, use that time to get vision or roam.
Heimerdinger.phase: In the late game, it's harder to decide a fight with one Zyra E Grasping Roots, so secure an advantage through vision and objectives beforehand.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: From behind your allies, Zyra should place seeds along the enemy's approach, then cut off the path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns when they engage. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the plants you have summoned to strengthen them. If Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is available, don't group together in a narrow passage or at one point in front of an objective.
Heimerdinger.watch: When you see the landing indicator, move sideways to avoid the center, and if you are hit, get out of turret range.

Hwei.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei's damage is mainly magic, and Zyra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Hwei.combo: After hitting Hwei with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where he is rooted, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed along the path while the ability is in flight to give Hwei less time to dodge. When casting Zyra R Stranglethorns, place it over the spot where you summoned plants first.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability, so the moment Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your chance to engage. Root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots then, and follow with Zyra R Stranglethorns to block his escape route.
Hwei.fight: Right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or waveclear, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots and close the distance. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back off because you have little to withstand a counterattack.
Hwei.laning: If Hwei steps forward, hit him first with Zyra E Grasping Roots and follow with seeds. When E is down, back off and build up seeds. If you push the wave with Zyra Q Deadly Spines, use that time to get vision or roam.
Hwei.phase: In the late game, it's harder to decide a fight with one Zyra E Grasping Roots, so secure an advantage through vision and objectives beforehand.
Hwei.teamfight: Prepare seeds along the enemy's approach from behind your allies, then cut off the path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns when they engage. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the plants, and if you hold Zyra E Grasping Roots until the knockup, you can root the enemy again right after they land. Avoid Hwei's ground effects and corridors with eyes, and take a wide route.
Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots you or forces you to move, you're likely to take follow-up damage, so don't engage first while this ability is available. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster and Hwei R Spiraling Despair apply slows. If one of Hwei's abilities hits you, move immediately to avoid his second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.

Janna.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Janna deals mostly magic damage, and Zyra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Janna R Monsoon’s healing is a problem, finish one core item, then buy Morellonomicon to reduce her healing.
Janna.combo: When Janna steps forward, root her with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed there, then hit her with Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed while Zyra E Grasping Roots is traveling to give Janna less time to dodge it. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants, and save Zyra E Grasping Roots if you’ll need to root her again after the knock-up.
Janna.escape: Look to engage when Janna Q Howling Gale misses and Janna E Eye Of The Storm is down. If Janna R Monsoon is down too, you can root her with Zyra E Grasping Roots and follow with Zyra R Stranglethorns without worrying about being pushed away. Account for Janna W Zephyr’s movement speed boost and ability to pass through minions; don’t try to block her with minions—hit her with your root.
Janna.fight: When Janna steps forward to protect an ally or place a ward, start a trade with Zyra E Grasping Roots. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back away.
Janna.laning: Poke the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm. If you also make her waste Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna W Zephyr, it becomes easier to take control of the lane. If you push the wave with Zyra Q Deadly Spines, use that time to establish vision or roam.
Janna.phase: Later in the game, it becomes harder to rely on a single Zyra E Grasping Roots, so secure an advantage with vision and objectives beforehand.
Janna.teamfight: From behind your allies, prepare Zyra W Rampant Growth seeds along the route enemies will use to engage. When they come in, cut off their path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants to empower them and look for a knock-up. Janna can stop an engage with Janna R Monsoon from behind your allied damage dealers, so establish vision and look for a chance to root her when she's isolated.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale can knock you up, so if you hear it charging in a brush or outside your vision, move out of its path. Janna E Eye Of The Storm absorbs damage and empowers the target’s counterattack, so don’t commit your damage while it’s active. Janna R Monsoon knocks back anyone who engages, so don’t force an approach while it’s available.

Karma.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Karma’s main damage is magic, and Zyra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a champion with strong healing, fit in Morellonomicon after finishing one core item.
Karma.combo: Root Karma with Zyra E Grasping Roots, throw a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed there, then hit her with Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed along the path after casting your ability to give Karma less time to dodge it. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants, and if you saved Zyra E Grasping Roots to time with the knock-up, root her again as soon as she lands.
Karma.escape: Bait out Karma W Focused Resolve, then create distance to break the tether and engage once the root threat is gone. You can also find an opening after the shield from Karma R Mantra E Inspire ends. Karma has no mobility spell, so close the distance, then catch her with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns.
Karma.fight: When Karma steps forward to protect her ADC or place a ward, start a trade with Zyra E Grasping Roots. Hold off on burst damage just after Karma E Inspire’s shield comes up; use your root and plant damage after the shield ends. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back away to avoid a counterattack.
Karma.laning: Against a Karma who pokes from range, prioritize seeds for Zyra Q Deadly Spines over the path of Zyra E Grasping Roots. If you push the wave, follow up by establishing vision or roaming.
Karma.phase: Later in the game, it becomes harder to catch someone with a single Zyra E Grasping Roots, so secure an advantage with vision and objectives beforehand.
Karma.teamfight: From behind your allies, spread seeds along the route enemies will use to engage, then cut off their path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns when they come in. While Karma W Focused Resolve is available, an ally who goes in first can get caught, so create distance and make Karma use it. If Karma R Mantra E Inspire shields nearby allies, wait for the shields to end, then fight with your plants and Zyra R Stranglethorns together.
Karma.watch: If Karma keeps hitting you with Karma Q Inner Flame, Karma P Gathering Fire will bring Karma R Mantra back sooner, so stay behind minions or outside its range. If the empowered Karma R Mantra Q Inner Flame leaves a burning area where it explodes, walk out of it immediately. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break the tether before it roots you.

Leona.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zyra has relatively low magic resistance, and Leona deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Leona.combo: Root Leona with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where she’s rooted, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed while your ability is traveling to give Leona less time to dodge or step on it. In teamfights, cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants.
Leona.escape: Immediately after baiting Leona into using Leona E Zenith Blade is your window to close the distance and counterattack. Root her with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then follow with Zyra R Stranglethorns to make it hard for her to escape.
Leona.fight: When Leona steps forward to protect her carry or place a ward, start a trade with Zyra E Grasping Roots if Leona E Zenith Blade is down. If Leona activates Leona W Eclipse, move out of range before it explodes to avoid letting her stay in the fight longer.
Leona.laning: Save Zyra E Grasping Roots to stop Leona’s engage. If it misses, back away and build up seeds. If you push the wave with Zyra Q Deadly Spines, use that time to establish vision or roam.
Leona.phase: Later in the game, Leona can dodge your root with mobility spells like Leona E Zenith Blade, so secure an advantage with vision and objectives beforehand.
Leona.teamfight: Set up seeds behind your allies, then cut off Leona’s path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns when she engages. If Leona P Sunlight marks you, that signals an incoming follow-up attack, so back away immediately.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and attaches to the last champion it hits, so don’t stand in a straight line with your allied ranged carry. Leona can activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak before approaching, so dodge based on her distance rather than whether she has used it. When the indicator for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the stun at its center.

Lux.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and buy Mercury's Treads. Lux’s main damage is magic, and Zyra has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Lux.combo: Dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then root her with Zyra E Grasping Roots. Place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where she’s rooted, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. If Lux is far away, invest seeds in the plant grown from Q rather than the short-range lash plant. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants.
Lux.escape: Engage after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no mobility spell, so once you’ve closed the distance, block her escape with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns.
Lux.fight: When Lux Q Light Binding misses, you have a chance to counterattack with Zyra E Grasping Roots. If Lux steps forward to protect her carry or place a ward, root her and deal damage with seeds and Zyra Q Deadly Spines.
Lux.laning: If E misses, back away and build up seeds. If you push the wave with Q, use that time to establish vision or roam.
Lux.phase: Later in the game, it becomes harder to decide a fight with a single Zyra E Grasping Roots, so secure an advantage with vision and objectives beforehand.
Lux.teamfight: From behind your allies, place seeds and spread out from them so you aren’t caught together in Lux E Lucent Singularity. Set up a plant along the route enemies will use to engage with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over it to stop their advance. If you’re low on health and retreating, move sideways when you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, her follow-up spells will follow, so bait out Q, dodge it, then move. Q roots the first two targets it hits, so don’t stand in a straight line with an ally. If Lux’s spell hits you and applies Illumination, get out of her basic attack range.

Maokai.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and buy Mercury's Treads. Build magic resistance first to defend against Maokai’s main damage, and get tenacity to deal with his root. If Maokai P Sap Magic’s healing is a problem, fit in Morellonomicon after finishing one core item.
Maokai.combo: After Maokai W Twisted Advance ends, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots. Place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where he’s rooted, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed while your ability is traveling to give Maokai less time to dodge or step on it. In teamfights, cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants.
Maokai.escape: Immediately after Maokai uses Maokai W Twisted Advance is your window to move in. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp is down too, dodge the root and control the engage path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns. Zyra has no spell to escape with, so don’t approach Maokai first while his W Twisted Advance and R Nature's Grasp are both available.
Maokai.fight: Immediately after baiting Maokai into using Maokai W Twisted Advance is your chance to close the distance and trade. Root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then attack with seeds and Zyra Q Deadly Spines. If you keep hitting Maokai with spells, Maokai P Sap Magic’s healing comes back sooner, so prioritize using your poke spells on the enemy carry.
Maokai.laning: When Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, don’t let him get within range of you near brush. Don’t use Zyra E Grasping Roots to clear the wave; save it to trade when Maokai steps forward or after he uses Maokai W Twisted Advance. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back away and build up seeds.
Maokai.phase: Later in the game, Maokai W Twisted Advance can help him escape Zyra E Grasping Roots or Zyra R Stranglethorns, so secure an advantage with vision and objectives beforehand.
Maokai.teamfight: From behind your allies, prepare seeds along the route enemies will use to engage, then cut off the path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns when Maokai comes in. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants, and dodge Maokai R Nature's Grasp sideways in open terrain. Start at the edge of your range so you aren’t the first one caught.
Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance dashes in and roots you, and Maokai can’t be targeted during the dash, so respond after he lands. Maokai E Sapling Toss produces a bigger explosion when planted in brush, so be careful entering brush. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp approaches from far away, dodge perpendicular to its path.

Milio.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and buy Mercury's Treads. Milio P Fired Up! and Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick deal magic damage, so build magic resistance against him. If the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life is a problem, fit in Morellonomicon after finishing one core item. If the healing gets stronger, prioritize healing reduction sooner.
Milio.combo: After hitting Milio with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where he’s rooted and hit him with Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed along the path while Zyra E Grasping Roots is traveling to give Milio less time to dodge. If Milio R Breath of Life is available, he can remove the root, so cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants to also look for a knock-up that it can’t cleanse.
Milio.escape: The moment Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down is your chance to close the distance. Root Milio with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then follow with Zyra R Stranglethorns. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses or is currently being used, back away; you have no way to withstand a counterattack.
Milio.fight: When Milio steps forward to protect his carry or moves to place a ward, start a trade with Zyra E Grasping Roots. After Milio uses Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick, he has no way to knock you back, so hit him with Zyra E Grasping Roots during that window and follow with plant damage. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back away and gather seeds.
Milio.laning: During the early laning phase, use a war of attrition to drain Milio’s mana and take control of the wave. Push with the thorn spitters grown from Zyra Q Deadly Spines, but save Zyra E Grasping Roots for when Milio steps forward. Use the time after pushing the wave to establish vision or roam for an advantage.
Milio.phase: Milio’s team composition gets stronger as the game goes on, so secure an advantage with vision and objectives before the late game.
Milio.teamfight: From behind your allies, prepare a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed along the route enemies will use to engage, then cut off their path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns as they come in. Use Zyra Q Deadly Spines and Zyra E Grasping Roots to set up plants, then cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over them. If you can target Milio, root him first to stop his healing, and take advantage of the fact that Milio R Breath of Life can remove roots but cannot remove knock-ups.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back and slows the first enemy it hits, so don’t force a close approach while it’s available. If the enemy carry attacks from farther away than usual, Milio W Cozy Campfire is active; wait for its duration to end. Milio R Breath of Life can remove the root from Zyra E Grasping Roots, but it can’t remove Zyra R Stranglethorns’ knock-up.

Morgana.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Morgana’s magic damage and buy Mercury's Treads. If a duel drags on due to Morgana P Soul Siphon and Morgana W Tormented Shadow, finish one core item, then buy Morellonomicon to reduce her healing.
Morgana.combo: After Morgana E Black Shield is down, root her with Zyra E Grasping Roots. Place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where she’s rooted, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed while Zyra E Grasping Roots is traveling to give Morgana less time to dodge.
Morgana.escape: Engage during the window when Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana E Black Shield are down. Morgana has no spell to create distance herself, so close the distance, then catch her with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns.
Morgana.fight: When Morgana E Black Shield is down, hit an advancing Morgana with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then deal damage with seeds and Zyra Q Deadly Spines. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back away; you have no way to withstand a counterattack.
Morgana.laning: Manage your distance so you overlap with minions and can block Morgana Q Dark Binding. If you push the wave, use that time to establish vision or roam.
Morgana.phase: Later in the game, it becomes harder to decide a fight with a single Zyra E Grasping Roots, so secure an advantage with vision and objectives beforehand.
Morgana.teamfight: Start behind your allies at the edge of your range, with seeds ready where your allies will stand and along the routes Morgana’s side will use to engage. Don’t waste Zyra E Grasping Roots on a target with Morgana E Black Shield active. Set up a plant along the engage path, then cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over it to stop the advance.
Morgana.watch: Morgana Q Dark Binding catches only the first target it hits, so move with minions between you and her. If your health is low, back away from Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If Morgana R Soul Shackles connects, leave its range before the stun triggers.

Nami.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Nami’s damage is mostly magic, and Zyra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. To reduce healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Nami.combo: When Nami Q Aqua Prison misses or Nami steps forward, root her first with Zyra E Grasping Roots. Place a seed while Zyra E Grasping Roots is traveling to give Nami less time to dodge in advance.
Nami.escape: Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to close the distance. Keep away from a target affected by Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing until the effect ends, then catch Nami, who has no mobility ability, with Zyra E Grasping Roots.
Nami.fight: Target Nami when she steps forward to protect her ADC or place a ward. Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, root her with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a seed where she’s rooted, and attack. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back off because you have little means to withstand a counterattack.
Nami.laning: If Zyra Q Deadly Spines pushes the lane, use the time you gain to establish vision or roam.
Nami.phase: In the late game, it becomes harder to catch a target with a single Zyra E Grasping Roots, so secure advantages through vision and objectives beforehand.
Nami.teamfight: Start behind your allies, prepare seeds in the paths enemies may take to engage, and begin fights at the edge of your range. When an enemy engages, cut off their path with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the spot where Zyra Q Deadly Spines has spawned plants. If you see Nami R Tidal Wave, dodge sideways and keep your distance so Zyra isn’t caught first.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns, and Nami R Tidal Wave knocks you up and can lead into follow-up attacks, making them dangerous for champions like Zyra with no escape ability. When you see either ability’s tell, walk sideways to dodge. Don’t fight head-on against a target affected by Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing; wait for the effect to end, then look for an opening again.

Nautilus.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Nautilus’s main damage is magic, and Zyra has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Nautilus.combo: When Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses or Nautilus steps forward, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed there, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed along the path while Zyra E Grasping Roots is traveling to give him less time to dodge in advance. When you cast Zyra R Stranglethorns, overlap it with the plants you spawned to enrage them.
Nautilus.escape: Bait out Nautilus Q Dredge Line, and if it misses, close the distance while rooting him with Zyra E Grasping Roots. While Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, he’ll have trouble sticking to you, so back away after attacking. Don’t engage first if Zyra E Grasping Roots is unavailable.
Nautilus.fight: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is your chance to trade. When Nautilus steps forward to protect his ADC or place a ward, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots and attack with a seed and Zyra Q Deadly Spines. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back off, and stay out of range of Nautilus P Staggering Blow’s basic attack.
Nautilus.laning: Don’t use Zyra E Grasping Roots to clear the wave; keep it ready for Nautilus’s approach. If Zyra Q Deadly Spines pushes the lane, use that time to establish vision or roam.
Nautilus.phase: In the late game, it becomes harder to set up a fight with a single Zyra E Grasping Roots, so lock in advantages through vision and objectives beforehand.
Nautilus.teamfight: Start behind your allies with seeds placed in the paths enemies may take to engage. When Nautilus engages, cut off his path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns. Overlap Zyra R Stranglethorns with the plants spawned by Zyra Q Deadly Spines or Zyra E Grasping Roots. If Nautilus R Depth Charge is ready, don’t stand on top of an ally.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage, so stand with minions between you and him to avoid being hit. If Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots you with his first basic attack, you’re likely to get hit by follow-up abilities, so don’t stay within his attack range. Nautilus R Depth Charge follows its target and knocks up allies along its path, so don’t stand on top of an ally.

Pantheon.build: Pantheon can engage and catch you, so buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier. Build armor first against the main damage from Pantheon Q Comet Spear, W Shield Vault, and E Aegis Assault. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Pantheon.combo: When you can root Pantheon, cast Zyra E Grasping Roots → Zyra W Rampant Growth on the rooted target → Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place a seed along the path after Zyra E Grasping Roots is cast to give Pantheon less time to dodge in advance. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is facing you, wait for it to end or deal damage from the side.
Pantheon.escape: When Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and he can’t use his stun and engage, that’s Zyra’s chance to fight. If Pantheon R Grand Starfall isn’t back up yet, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots and R Stranglethorns. Deal damage after Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends as well.
Pantheon.fight: Start outside the range of Pantheon W Shield Vault and root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots when he steps forward. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, wait for it to end before attacking.
Pantheon.laning: In the early game, keep minions between you and Pantheon to reduce poke damage from Pantheon Q Comet Spear and avoid giving up a kill. Start a trade with Zyra E Grasping Roots when Pantheon walks forward, but if it misses, back away and build up seeds. Keep at least one charge of Zyra W Rampant Growth before the fight.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s influence falls off in the late game, but it also becomes harder for Zyra to win a fight with a single E Grasping Roots, so secure advantages through vision and objectives beforehand.
Pantheon.teamfight: Start behind your allies with seeds ready in the paths Pantheon may take to engage. When Pantheon engages, cut off his path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and overlap R Stranglethorns with the plants you spawned. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted enemy, so cut off his approach with Zyra E Grasping Roots before he gets in range. Stand with minions between you and Pantheon to reduce the poke from Pantheon Q Comet Spear. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.

Pyke.build: Pyke is a major threat because he can engage and catch you, so buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier. Consider Morellonomicon to reduce healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones after completing one core item. Armor is more appropriate than magic resistance against Pyke’s damage, but also get health to account for penetration and the execution threshold on Pyke R Death From Below.
Pyke.combo: When you can root Pyke, cast Zyra E Grasping Roots → Zyra W Rampant Growth → Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed along Zyra E Grasping Roots’s path while it’s traveling to give Pyke less time to dodge in advance. Where Pyke engages, spawn plants and overlap Zyra R Stranglethorns to block his path.
Pyke.escape: If you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side, you get a chance to counterattack with Zyra E Grasping Roots where Pyke used his engage. However, Pyke can also move with Pyke R Death From Below, so don’t go deep just because Pyke E Phantom Undertow is down. When both Pyke R Death From Below is still down and Pyke E Phantom Undertow has been used, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns.
Pyke.fight: When Pyke steps forward, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then follow up with a seed and Zyra Q Deadly Spines. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back off because you have little means to withstand a counterattack. Look for an opening to engage after dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side and while Pyke R Death From Below is still down.
Pyke.laning: When Pyke backs away, maintain vision to prevent healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, and place a Control Ward at the brush entrance.
Pyke.phase: In the late game, Pyke can dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots with mobility abilities like Pyke E Phantom Undertow and Pyke R Death From Below, so move behind your allies to avoid being caught first.
Pyke.teamfight: Start behind your allies with seeds in the paths enemies may take to engage. When Pyke engages, cut off his path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the spot with plants, and if you’ve held Zyra E Grasping Roots until the knock-up, root him again as soon as he lands. Don’t stand next to low-health allies, so you aren’t caught together in Pyke R Death From Below’s area.
Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls you or Pyke E Phantom Undertow stuns you, Zyra has no escape ability and is likely to get hit by follow-up attacks. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, dodge to the side of its dash path. If you see the shark shadow from Pyke W Ghostwater Dive beneath your feet, retreat toward your allies or turret.

Rakan.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Rakan’s damage is mostly magic, and Zyra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Rakan.combo: After rooting Rakan with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed on the rooted target and cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Placing the seed while E is traveling gives Rakan less time to dodge in advance.
Rakan.escape: Right after Rakan W Grand Entrance is down is your chance to close the distance and catch him with Zyra E Grasping Roots. Rakan E Battle Dance can only target allied champions, so look for an opening when Rakan is also moving alone, away from his allies.
Rakan.fight: Look for an opening right after Rakan P Fey Feathers’s shield breaks. After dodging Rakan W Grand Entrance, hit him with Zyra E Grasping Roots where he steps forward and trade.
Rakan.laning: When Rakan steps forward to protect his ADC or place a ward, use Zyra E Grasping Roots. If it misses, back away and build up seeds.
Rakan.phase: In the late game, Rakan can dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan E Battle Dance, so it’s hard to rely on a single root.
Rakan.teamfight: Start behind your allies at the edge of your range, and place seeds where your allies will stand and in Rakan’s engage path before the fight. If Rakan engages with W Grand Entrance, catch him with Zyra E Grasping Roots right after he lands, then overlap Zyra R Stranglethorns with the plants in his path to block it.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance knocks you up at its landing point after a dash, so step sideways as soon as Rakan starts moving. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots before he reaches you or put terrain between you, and don’t stand in a line with your allies.

Rell.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Rell’s damage is mostly magic, and Zyra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Rell.combo: When you can catch Rell, root her with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed there, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed while Zyra E Grasping Roots is traveling to give Rell less time to dodge or step on it. In teamfights, overlap Zyra R Stranglethorns with the plants you spawned.
Rell.escape: Don’t engage as soon as Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down; check whether Rell E Full Tilt is down too. Rell has a hard time escaping if you use Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns before Rell E Full Tilt comes back up.
Rell.fight: Chip away at Rell’s health with magic damage from outside the short range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Hit Rell with Zyra E Grasping Roots when she steps forward, and back off if it misses to avoid a counterattack. After Rell uses W Ferromancy: Crash Down, create distance so Rell is left alone.
Rell.laning: If Rell charges in with E Full Tilt, give up the trade and back off. While Zyra E Grasping Roots is down, build up seeds from behind.
Rell.phase: In the late game, Rell’s mobility makes it harder to catch her with a single Zyra E Grasping Roots.
Rell.teamfight: Stay behind your allies and spread out so multiple people aren’t pulled together by Rell R Magnet Storm. Before the fight, place seeds where your allies will stand and in Rell’s engage path. When Rell engages, cut off her path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the spot with plants.
Rell.watch: When Rell E Full Tilt speeds up Rell and one ally together, treat it as an engage signal: stop trading and move outside the range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. If Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down catches you, it can lead into Rell R Magnet Storm, so don’t use Zyra E Grasping Roots carelessly and keep your distance. Dodge Rell Q Shattering Strike by stepping to the side.

Renata.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Renata Glasc’s damage is mostly magic, and Zyra has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a champion with strong healing, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Renata.combo: When Renata Glasc steps forward, root her with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed on the rooted target, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed while Zyra E Grasping Roots is traveling to give her less time to dodge in advance. Overlap Zyra R Stranglethorns with the grown plants, and save Zyra E Grasping Roots if you want to root her again after the knock-up.
Renata.escape: After dodging Renata Glasc Q Handshake, you have a chance to engage with Zyra E Grasping Roots. Renata Glasc has no mobility ability, so she has a hard time escaping if you close the distance and root her. Don’t engage while standing close together with your allies while Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is ready.
Renata.fight: If Renata Glasc steps forward to protect her ADC or place a ward, root her with Zyra E Grasping Roots and add a seed. Renata Glasc has no mobility ability, so if you successfully close the distance and root her, follow up with Zyra R Stranglethorns.
Renata.laning: If Zyra Q Deadly Spines pushes the lane, use that time to establish vision or roam. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses or is unavailable, back away and build up seeds.
Renata.phase: In the late game, it becomes harder to catch someone with a single Zyra E Grasping Roots, so create zones from behind your allies.
Renata.teamfight: Before the fight, place seeds where your allies will stand and along the enemy engage path, and start at the edge of your range from behind. When the enemy engages, cut off their path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns, overlapping Zyra R Stranglethorns with the plants. While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is ready, keep your distance from allies. Right after killing an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, back off so your allies don’t die.
Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots the first target hit and throws them, which can stun allies too, so dodge it from behind minions or your frontline. Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program travels in a straight line and deals damage and slows, so dodge sideways. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover hits you, you attack nearby allies, so keep your distance from them while you’re within its range.

Senna.build: Finish one core item first, then fit in Morellonomicon to counter the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness. Since Senna deals primarily physical damage, prioritize armor when building resistances.
Senna.combo: When Senna steps forward, root her with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where she is rooted, then hit her with Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed while your ability is traveling to give Senna less time to dodge in advance or destroy the seed by stepping on it. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace misses, stay clear of its root, then engage with Zyra E Grasping Roots when Senna steps forward to collect a soul.
Senna.fight: Start a trade with Zyra E Grasping Roots when Senna steps forward to collect a soul or moves to ward. If you miss Zyra E Grasping Roots, retreat and collect seeds, since it will be difficult to withstand her counterattack.
Senna.laning: Watch where souls spawn and wait along Senna’s path to collect them so you can harass her. If you push the wave with Zyra Q Deadly Spines, use that time to ward or roam.
Senna.phase: If you leave Senna alone early, her attack range and attack damage will keep scaling, so secure vision and objective advantages before the late game.
Senna.teamfight: Prepare seeds behind your allies along the enemy’s approach, then block their engage with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, retreat to an area where you have vision or cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines into the mist to deter an engage. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions, slowing enemies and healing allies, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions. If it hits you, move away from your allies before the root detonates. After Senna hits you once, retreat immediately so she cannot land a second attack and collect Mist.

Seraphine.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Seraphine, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Since Seraphine deals primarily magic damage and Zyra has relatively low magic resistance, build magic resistance first. If healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound is a problem, finish one core item before fitting in Morellonomicon.
Seraphine.combo: To catch Seraphine, root her with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where she is rooted, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed while Zyra E Grasping Roots is traveling to give Seraphine less time to dodge. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants to enrage them and aim to knock her up.
Seraphine.escape: Close the gap right after Seraphine E Beat Drop misses. Seraphine has no mobility, so this is a chance to catch her with Zyra E Grasping Roots and follow with Zyra R Stranglethorns. Zyra also has no escape ability, so keep your distance while Seraphine still has crowd control available.
Seraphine.fight: Look to trade when Seraphine is alone and separated from her ADC, or right after you let Seraphine E Beat Drop pass without hitting you. Root her first with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then follow up with plant damage. If you miss Zyra E Grasping Roots, retreat because you have few ways to withstand her counterattack.
Seraphine.laning: If Zyra E Grasping Roots is unavailable, retreat and build up seeds.
Seraphine.phase: It becomes harder to win a fight with one Zyra E Grasping Roots in the late game, so secure vision and objective advantages beforehand.
Seraphine.teamfight: Start behind your allies and place seeds in advance where they will stand and along the enemy’s approach. Spread out to either side so Seraphine R Encore does not extend through your allies. When the enemy engages, block their path with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the plants you placed with Zyra Q Deadly Spines.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots targets that are already slowed and stuns targets that are immobilized. If you are slowed, immediately move out of the line in front of Seraphine. In teamfights, Seraphine R Encore extends each time it hits one of your allied champions, so spread out from your allies to either side.

Sona.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Sona’s primary magic damage, then choose Mercury’s Treads. To counter healing from Sona W Aria of Perseverance, finish one core item before fitting in Morellonomicon.
Sona.combo: Root Sona with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where she is rooted, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed while Zyra E Grasping Roots is traveling to give Sona less time to dodge. In teamfights, cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the plants you placed.
Sona.escape: After Sona uses Sona R Crescendo, you no longer need to wait while watching for that stun, so look for an angle as she steps forward. Start your engage with Zyra E Grasping Roots before Sona E Song of Celerity is activated or after its movement speed effect ends.
Sona.fight: Root Sona first with Zyra E Grasping Roots when she steps forward to share the aura from Sona W Aria of Perseverance or moves to ward. Follow up on the rooted target with a seed and Zyra Q Deadly Spines so she can’t escape with the movement speed from Sona E Song of Celerity. If you miss Zyra E Grasping Roots, retreat and collect seeds.
Sona.laning: If you push the wave with Zyra Q Deadly Spines and plants, use that time to ward or roam.
Sona.phase: Sona gets stronger over time, so don’t wait until the late game; secure vision and objective advantages.
Sona.teamfight: Prepare seeds behind your allies along the enemy’s approach, then stop enemies who engage with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants. Spread out to either side so you aren’t all hit by Sona R Crescendo. Separating Sona from her allies reduces the number of targets reached by her healing, shielding, and movement speed auras.
Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns everyone hit in a line, so don’t stand in a line with your allies when Sona steps forward. If Sona suddenly enters basic attack range, watch for her empowered Sona P Power Chord attack and create distance. Sona E Song of Celerity increases her movement speed, so don’t rely on slows alone to chase her.

Soraka.build: In the early game, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Soraka deals primarily magic damage, so build magic resistance. Finish one core item before fitting in Morellonomicon to reduce Soraka’s healing.
Soraka.combo: Root Soraka with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where she is rooted, then cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Cast Zyra E Grasping Roots first, then throw the seed along its path to give Soraka less time to dodge. If you need to keep Soraka rooted, cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants and save Zyra E Grasping Roots to land as she is knocked up.
Soraka.escape: Look to engage when Soraka E Equinox is used to harass or clear the wave. Start with Zyra E Grasping Roots before stepping into the silence zone. Soraka has no mobility, so close the gap and block her escape with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns.
Soraka.fight: Look to catch Soraka with Zyra E Grasping Roots as soon as Soraka E Equinox is down. Soraka has no mobility, so once you close the gap and root her, unload damage with Zyra W Rampant Growth and Zyra Q Deadly Spines. If you miss Zyra E Grasping Roots, retreat to avoid her counterattack.
Soraka.laning: Keep pressuring your allied ADC to force Soraka W Astral Infusion, but dodge Soraka Q Starcall to keep draining Soraka’s health.
Soraka.phase: It becomes harder to decide a fight with one Zyra E Grasping Roots in the late game, so secure vision and objective advantages beforehand.
Soraka.teamfight: Set up an approach with seeds behind your allies, then block the enemy’s path with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns when they engage. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over the plants you summon with Zyra Q Deadly Spines or Zyra E Grasping Roots. Root Soraka herself and focus damage on her in a short burst rather than continually attacking enemies she heals.
Soraka.watch: If Soraka Q Starcall hits you, Soraka heals and gains movement speed, interrupting your pressure. Soraka E Equinox can silence and root you within its zone, so cast Zyra E Grasping Roots before stepping into it or avoid the zone. Keep Soraka R Wish in mind when trying to finish someone off, as it heals allies regardless of distance.

Taric.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Taric’s magic damage, then choose Mercury’s Treads. If healing from Taric Q Starlight’s Touch is a problem, finish one core item before using Morellonomicon to reduce healing.
Taric.combo: Root Taric with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where he is rooted, then hit him with Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Cast Zyra E Grasping Roots, then place the seed along its path to give Taric less time to dodge. If Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, stop attacking and resume dealing damage when it ends.
Taric.escape: Look to engage after dodging Taric E Dazzle. Taric has no ability to create distance, so catch him with Zyra E Grasping Roots and, if needed, follow with Zyra R Stranglethorns to keep him from escaping.
Taric.fight: Right after dodging Taric E Dazzle, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots and deal damage from outside his range. Keep your distance so Taric can’t stick close and keep landing empowered basic attacks. Attack again when Taric R Cosmic Radiance’s damage immunity ends.
Taric.laning: While Taric E Dazzle is available, keep your distance and watch the allies linked by Taric W Bastion. If Taric steps forward to protect his ADC or ward and you dodge the stun, start a trade with Zyra E Grasping Roots. If you miss Zyra E Grasping Roots, retreat and collect seeds.
Taric.phase: It becomes harder to turn a fight with one Zyra E Grasping Roots in the late game, so secure vision and objective advantages beforehand.
Taric.teamfight: Prepare seeds behind your allies and block the approach of Taric or his linked ally with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, hold the enemy with roots and knockups instead of unloading damage. Attack again as soon as the immunity ends.
Taric.watch: Taric E Dazzle has a tell before it stuns, so dodge to the side when you see it. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, stop attacking and hold targets in place with Zyra E Grasping Roots or Zyra R Stranglethorns.

Thresh.build: In the early game, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Thresh’s main ability damage is magic, so build magic resistance, but Tenacity is also important because Zyra has no ability to escape once caught.
Thresh.combo: When Thresh steps forward, root him first with Zyra E Grasping Roots, throw a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where he is rooted, then hit him with Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Cast the seed along the path after using your ability to give Thresh less time to dodge or step on it. You can also block the approach by casting Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants before Thresh W Dark Passage comes back up.
Thresh.escape: Right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence is a chance to close the gap, but an escape is still possible if Thresh W Dark Passage is available. Look to use Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns before Thresh W Dark Passage comes back up. Don’t engage first while Zyra E Grasping Roots is down.
Thresh.fight: Look for an opening when Thresh steps forward to collect a soul or misses Thresh Q Death Sentence. Root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then deal damage with seeds and Zyra Q Deadly Spines. If you miss Zyra E Grasping Roots, retreat to avoid his counterattack.
Thresh.laning: Move side to side and keep your distance instead of walking in a straight line to dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence. If you push the wave, use that time to ward or roam.
Thresh.phase: It becomes harder to end a fight with one Zyra E Grasping Roots in the late game, so secure vision and objective advantages beforehand.
Thresh.teamfight: Place seeds behind your allies along the enemy’s approach, then block Thresh’s engage with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants. If Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown, either finish off the target immediately or retreat. If caught in Thresh R The Box, choose an escape direction and have your toughest ally break through one wall.
Thresh.watch: If Thresh Q Death Sentence hits you, Thresh will charge in, and you may then be pulled by Thresh E Flay. Move to the side when you see him raise his hook, and change direction again when stepping forward to last-hit. Don’t stand on the line between Thresh and his ally either.

Velkoz.build: In the early game, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Vel’Koz’s primary damage, but the true damage from Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction and Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray cannot be blocked by resistance, so prioritize avoiding successive ability hits.
Velkoz.combo: When you have a chance to hit Vel’Koz, root him first with Zyra E Grasping Roots. Then place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where he is rooted and cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Cast Zyra R Stranglethorns over your plants to increase their damage and aim for a knockup.
Velkoz.escape: Look to engage right after dodging or forcing Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Vel’Koz has no mobility, so close the gap, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots, and block his escape with Zyra R Stranglethorns.
Velkoz.fight: After dodging Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots and deal damage with seeds and Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Vel’Koz has no mobility, so clearing vision in the river or tri-brush and approaching from the side can create a chance to land your root.
Velkoz.laning: If you miss Zyra E Grasping Roots, retreat to avoid a counterattack and build up seeds. If you push the wave, use that time to ward or roam.
Velkoz.phase: It becomes harder to catch someone with one root in the late game, so control the approach from a safe position.
Velkoz.teamfight: Place seeds behind your allies along the enemy’s approach and block the engage with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns. When Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray begins, prioritize interrupting it with the knockup from Zyra R Stranglethorns. If you can’t interrupt it immediately, retreat behind a wall or beyond minions to break vision.
Velkoz.watch: Vel’Koz Q Plasma Fission splits into two bolts at the end, so don’t only dodge sideways; move toward Vel’Koz or behind where the beam passed. If you’re hit by successive abilities, Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction triggers true damage, so retreat and let it expire when you get a stack. Be especially careful when engaging so you don’t get knocked up by Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption.

Xerath.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Xerath’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots, and prioritize magic resistance over armor.
Xerath.combo: Root Xerath with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed at that spot and cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Place the seed while the ability is traveling to give Xerath less time to dodge. If a plant is standing where Xerath is rooted, layer Zyra R Stranglethorns there.
Xerath.escape: The moment Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to engage. Xerath has no mobility, so close the distance and catch him with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns.
Xerath.fight: Dodge to the side while Xerath charges Q Arcanopulse and close the distance. Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are down, root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots and trade damage with seeds and Zyra Q Deadly Spines.
Xerath.laning: Farm while avoiding heavy damage, and wait for Xerath to spend a lot of mana. Then push the lane and call your jungler. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back off and build up your seeds.
Xerath.phase: In the late game, it’s hard to rely on landing Zyra E Grasping Roots once, so secure an advantage with vision and objectives beforehand.
Xerath.teamfight: Prepare seeds behind your allies at choke points the enemy might use to engage. Stop an enemy engage with Zyra E Grasping Roots, then layer Zyra R Stranglethorns where your plants are standing to cut off their path in. Start dodging when you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and dodge to the side. Be especially wary of Xerath E Shocking Orb, since being stunned can leave you vulnerable to follow-up damage. Start dodging as soon as you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.

Zilean.build: Most of Zilean’s damage is magic, and Zyra has relatively low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots to help against the stun from Zilean Q Time Bomb and the slow from Zilean E Time Warp. If the enemy team has a champion with strong healing, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Zilean.combo: After hitting Zilean with Zyra E Grasping Roots, place a Zyra W Rampant Growth seed where he is rooted and cast Zyra Q Deadly Spines. Placing the seed while the ability is traveling gives Zilean less time to dodge. Don’t spend your abilities on a target affected by Zilean R Chronoshift while they are reviving; wait for the effect to end or prepare to attack again as soon as they revive.
Zilean.escape: Zilean has no mobility, so dodge the stun from Zilean Q Time Bomb, then close the distance and look for a chance to root him with Zyra E Grasping Roots. Zilean E Time Warp can only be used on one person at a time, so approach from multiple directions with your allies to avoid being stopped all at once. Avoid engaging alone, getting slowed, and taking the bomb combo.
Zilean.fight: When Zilean steps forward to protect an ally or place a ward, start a damage trade with Zyra E Grasping Roots. If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, back off and build up your seeds.
Zilean.laning: If you’ve pushed the lane with Zyra Q Deadly Spines, use the time you’ve gained to establish vision or roam.
Zilean.phase: In the late game, one Zyra E Grasping Roots is unlikely to decide the fight, so hold choke points behind your allies.
Zilean.teamfight: Before a fight, plant seeds where your allies will stand and at choke points the enemy might use to engage. Stop an enemy engage with Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns. Use Zyra Q Deadly Spines and Zyra E Grasping Roots to spawn plants, then layer Zyra R Stranglethorns over them. If Zilean R Chronoshift is on an allied damage dealer and makes them hard to kill, target Zilean himself, since he has no mobility and is weak.
Zilean.watch: Zilean Q Time Bomb stuns when it sticks twice, so move away from your allies as soon as the first bomb attaches and get outside its blast radius.
